resources.string: Your journey, even when the signal isn\'t.
No internet connection. Your downloaded maps remain available.
Search needs an internet connection for this area.
The request took too long. Check your connection and try again.
Map service access was rejected. The access token may be invalid or expired. Update it and rebuild.
Too many requests right now. Wait a moment and try again.
We couldn\'t find that. Try a different search.
No route found between these stops. Try changing a stop or the travel mode.
The service is having trouble. Please try again shortly.
Map services aren\'t set up in this build. Add a Mapbox token and rebuild.
Can\'t get your location. Turn on device location, and step outdoors if you are inside.
Location permission is off. Allow it in Settings to see where you are.
Not enough storage for this download. Free up space or choose a smaller area.
Downloads are set to Wi-Fi only. Connect to Wi-Fi or change this in Settings.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
You\'re offline. Downloaded maps and saved places still work.
Weak connection. Some results may be missing or out of date.
Mapbox token not configured. Add MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=pk.… to local.properties and rebuild.
A secret Mapbox token (sk.…) was supplied. Use a public token (pk.…) in local.properties and rebuild.
The Mapbox token looks malformed. It must start with pk. Fix MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN in local.properties and rebuild.
